page_title: LAZ 1-1 JUV | Lazio v Juventus 10/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The match has just finished.
90+10' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
90+6' 1 - 1 Goal! Matias Vecino (Lazio) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:1.
90+3' The foul by Weston McKennie (Juventus) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Davide Massa.
90+2' The main referee, Davide Massa, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is given a yellow card for dissent.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Matias Vecino (Lazio) for a tough tackle.
90' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) protests to the referee and receives a yellow card.
89' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Lazio, play can continue.
88' There's a break in play and referee Davide Massa must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Lazio using VAR. This could be interesting!
88' PENALTY APPEAL by Lazio, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!

87' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just over the bar. Unlucky! The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
87' The ball is out of play. Lazio win a corner kick.
86' Christos Mandas (Lazio) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
86' The referee allows time for a substitution. Francisco Conceicao will be replaced by Federico Gatti (Juventus).
86' Igor Tudor prepares a substitution. Vasilije Adzic is replaced by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus).
85' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Davide Massa saw the whole situation. Lazio will take a free kick.
83' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
82' Mario Gila (Lazio) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
81' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Juventus, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
80' A yellow card is awarded to Luca Pellegrini (Lazio).
80' Pedro (Lazio) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Michele Di Gregorio stops the ball out of the bottom right corner.
79' Igor Tudor is forced to make a change. Alberto Costa is unable to continue due to injury, Douglas Luiz (Juventus) comes on.
79' Alberto Costa (Juventus) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
77' Pedro (Lazio) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
76' We are about to witness a subsitution. Vasilije Adzic (Juventus) for Randal Kolo Muani.
75' Mario Gila (Lazio) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
75' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lazio.
75' Juventus concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Free kick. Lazio will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
73' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
72' Michele Di Gregorio (Juventus) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
72' Michele Di Gregorio (Juventus) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
71' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
69' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) sees a yellow card from Davide Massa after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
68' Pedro (Lazio) serves up a nice cross, but Michele Di Gregorio punches the ball away.
65' Here is a change. Nicolo Rovella is going off and Marco Baroni gives the last tactical orders to Matias Vecino (Lazio).
65' The game has come to an end for Adam Marusic. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Manuel Lazzari (Lazio).
64' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Luca Pellegrini (Lazio).
60' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) receives a red card after his awful challenge. He completely lost his temper and referee Davide Massa sends him off the pitch.
57' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lazio, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
55' Today's referee Davide Massa rightly decides to book Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) for his harsh tackle.
53' Gustav Isaksen will be replaced by Pedro (Lazio).
53' Marco Baroni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Boulaye Dia (Lazio) replacing Fisayo Dele-Bashiru.
51' 0 - 1 Goal! Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Weston McKennie and easily beat the keeper with a header into the right side of the goal from close range. 0:1.
51' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
49' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) is flagged for offside.
48' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.

47' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
47' Alberto Costa (Juventus) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
46' Igor Tudor has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) comes on the pitch for Nicolas Gonzalez.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' Davide Massa has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Mario Gila (Lazio) jumps into a tackle and Davide Massa signals a foul. Juventus are awarded a free kick.
45' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) sends a cross into the box, but Michele Di Gregorio comes off his line to gather the ball.
45' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
44' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
42' Renato Veiga (Juventus) unleashes a shot from the free kick, but blazes it over. This is a perfect example of a wasted chance. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
41' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) tackles a bit over-zealously and Davide Massa blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Juventus, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
39' Davide Massa interrupts the game. One of the players from Juventus won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Lazio are awarded the free kick.
35' A corner kick by Juventus is thwarted by the well prepared Christos Mandas (Lazio).
34' Alberto Costa (Juventus) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. Juventus get a corner.
34' A lofted cross from Khephren Thuram (Juventus) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
32' A player from Lazio commits a rough challenge. Davide Massa blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Juventus have a free kick.
32' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
31' Renato Veiga (Juventus) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Davide Massa blows for a foul. Lazio have a free kick.
28' Nicolo Savona (Juventus) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
27' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Juventus.
25' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
24' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Juventus get a free kick.
24' A player from Lazio pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. Juventus have a free kick.
23' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
22' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
21' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Khephren Thuram (Juventus), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

19' Juventus are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
16' Juventus fail to score from a corner as Christos Mandas (Lazio) leaps to collect the ball.
15' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Khephren Thuram (Juventus) is thwarted and cleared to safety. Juventus will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
13' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
13' The Lazio players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
11' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! There is a free kick near the sideline to Lazio.
11' Mario Gila (Lazio) commits a rough challenge and Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul. Juventus have been awarded a free kick.
10' Half-chance! Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) plays a pass into the box, but Michele Di Gregorio reacts well to snuff out the attack.

9' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
8' Adam Marusic (Lazio) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Juventus.
7' Davide Massa blows his whistle. Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick to Juventus.
5' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
4' The referee blows his whistle as Khephren Thuram (Juventus) was too aggressive in his challenge. Lazio earn a free kick.
3' The ball goes out of play. Lazio are awarded a corner kick.

3' Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Michele Di Gregorio guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The referee points to the corner flag and Lazio will take a corner.
1' Timothy Weah (Juventus) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
1' The first half has started.
Juventus will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Davide Massa.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
